projects.name: Project Kati

projects.name: Project Dorothy
projects.quote: Completed Spring Demand Response Period and Began Summer Period – As part of its ● Demand Response Plan, Soluna has earned $1.2 million for the six months ended June 2024 at Project Dorothy.
